Project File 06 / Architecture Exploration

Q-FLOW28-PF —
cryptography in hardware.

A programmable post-quantum cryptography fabric architecture targeting a TSMC 28 nm node.

PQC · APB4 · AXI4 ● Architecture work · Not fabricated
01 / Design intent
02 / Resource plan
03 / Integration
04 / Proof still needed

Design intent

Explore a shared hardware accelerator platform for post-quantum cryptographic primitives, with secure memory boundaries and high-throughput data movement. This project is at the architecture stage; listed blocks represent specification targets.

Architecture scope

  • Shared NTT/INTT engine and modular polynomial arithmetic.
  • Keccak-f[1600] state hashing support.
  • Dedicated X25519 elliptic curve datapath.
  • ML-KEM-512/768/1024 and ML-DSA-44/65/87 algorithm targets.

System interfaces and security blocks

APB4 control register interface, AXI4 master/slave data movement, secure scratchpad memory, internal key vault, TRNG/DRBG, and a security root-of-trust controller form the architectural roadmap.

Target: TSMC 28 nm node. There is no tapeout claim or silicon measurement on this page.

Work needed before implementation claims

Freeze the supported algorithm parameter sets, define the threat model and security boundaries, quantify shared-resource scheduling and memory traffic, then verify functional correctness and constant-time execution behavior before starting physical design.
